rec.name: Homepage Featured Collection (Bestsellers Slider with Filter Tags, Quick ATC & Variant Swatches)
rec.status: Spec written; dev raised theme-conflict concern (custom section vs. customizing the theme's native featured collection) — decision pending, no launch confirmed

what.text: A homepage section that showcases products from one or more Shopify collections (e.g. "Unsere Bestseller" / Our Bestsellers). It has a headline, optional subheadline and body text, and clickable filter tags above the products (e.g. Pendelleuchte, Stehleuchte, Deckenleuchte, Akkuleuchte). Product cards show an image, a discount badge ("-20%" on mobile, "Bis 50,00€ Ersparnis" (up to €50 savings) on desktop), a quick add-to-cart basket button on the image (mobile), the product name, the price with the strike-through original price ("ab 119,90€" next to "149,90€"), and color-variant swatches. Products display as a horizontal slider with a progress bar and arrows (desktop), plus an "Alle anzeigen" (View all) link. The ticket also asks for Grid and Pagination display modes.

why.text: Bringing bestsellers to the homepage shortens the path to product pages for visitors who aren't yet sure what they want. Category filter tags let shoppers self-select quickly, which reduces browsing effort. Visible discount badges and strike-through prices anchor value and create a sense of a deal. Color swatches and a quick ATC button remove clicks between interest and cart. The bestseller framing acts as implicit social proof.

how.text: Ticket asks for a custom Shopify section with theme-editor settings for typography, colors, collection selection, filter tags, product card display, product count and layout (grid/slider/pagination). The developer (Rana) warned that variant switching with thumbnail updates, Ajax ATC and Quick View are tied to the theme's native code, and a fully custom section could break them. Recommended approach from dev: customize the theme's default featured-collection section to match the design rather than build from scratch. Final decision is not documented in the ticket. Build tip: reuse the theme's product-card snippet so swatches, Ajax ATC and Quick View keep working; implement filter tags as tabs that swap between collections or collection-tag filters; add a discount badge computed from compare_at_price.

items: Subheadline text, font, size, bold, alignment (left/center)
Select one or more Shopify collections
Configurable filter tags above products (e.g. Pendelleuchte, Stehleuchte)
Add-to-cart button directly in the grid
Product name: font, size, bold, alignment
Price: font, size, color, bold, alignment, currency symbol
Percentage discount badge (when a compare-at price exists)

dependencies.text: Depends on the theme's native product card functions (Ajax ATC, Quick View, variant-swap with thumbnail update). Requires Shopify Collections with compare-at prices for discount badges, and color-variant options for swatches. Collection tags/filters need either collection handles or product tags. No third-party app is mentioned.

images.caption: Mobile view: headline, body text, scrollable filter tags, product cards with -20% badge, basket ATC button, strike-through price and color swatches
Desktop view: 'Unsere Bestseller' slider with savings badges, strike-through prices, swatches, progress bar, arrows and 'Alle anzeigen' link
